item.title: Chart Templates for Data Visualization
item.description:
Product managers present constantly: they finish a research study → share the findings; a new quarter kicks off → announce goals; a quarter, half-year, or year wraps up → review results; and so on.

Data visualization tends to be the weak spot in these presentations, so I put together a Google Sheets template where I’ll collect and update reference chart examples for the most common product, business, and financial data.

item.title: A/B Test Design Template
item.description:
A Google Sheets template for designing A/B tests. It helps you structure an experiment before launch — from hypothesis formulation to test duration calculation.

Download template

What’s inside

Experiment description — a hypothesis statement in the format: «If [product change], then [target metric] will change by [expected result], because [research data].» This section also captures the target metric and experiment start date.
